text: もしかして　きみは　ものを　あつめるの　すきなのか…？

structure.jp: ものを　あつめるの

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の turns a verb phrase into a thing you can like. ものを　あつめるの = 'collecting things'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか asks about a reason or checks a guess. すきなのか = 'is it that you like it?'.
